item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] No signal clears the board's historical-elevation threshold
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: Upstream board reports: no signal exceeds its own history beyond what chance explains. 39 of 39 configured sources report; 6 are live.
